prerequisites: Basic mathematical knowledge required to pass the entrance exam for the undergraduate program.

learning_outcomes.text: Acquired familiarity with the concepts of vector space, linear function, matrices and their properties, scalar products, and symmetric bilinear forms.
Develop solid skills in calculations involving vectors and matrices.
Be able to apply these concepts to solve concrete problems in linear algebra and basic analytic geometry, especially regarding linear subvarieties in affine spaces.

syllabus_topics: Intersections, sums, and direct sums of subspaces
Eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and eigenspaces of endomorphisms or matrices
Scalar products in real vector spaces
Points, lines, and planes in space

assessment_methods.method: Oral exam (potentially required based on written exam)

assessment_rules: The assessment consists of a written final exam and midterm tests. Based on the outcome of the written exam, the instructor may also require an oral exam. The written exam includes theoretical questions and exercises to verify application of knowledge. Evaluation is based on completeness of knowledge, ability to apply knowledge, logical consistency and accuracy, and clarity in theoretical explanations. Generative AI tools are not permitted.
bibliography: F. Bottacin, Exercises on Linear Algebra and Geometry, Esculapio, 2023.
institution: Università degli Studi di Padova — Information Engineering (L-8)
degree: Laurea in Information Engineering (Information Engineering), classe L-8 R Ingegneria dell'informazione
